summary: Tested Sala de Operaciones (Surgery Module) - Backend 22/22 tests passed, Frontend UI working correctly. Fixed permission bug where surgery endpoints used non-existent 'manage_expenses' permission instead of 'create_expenses'/'edit_expenses'.

fixed.issue: Used non-existent 'manage_expenses' permission - Admin couldn't create/edit surgeries
fixed.fix: Changed to 'create_expenses' for POST and 'edit_expenses' for PUT/DELETE equipment/supplies

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: Surgery endpoints used 'manage_expenses' permission which doesn't exist in PERMISSIONS dict. Changed to 'create_expenses' and 'edit_expenses' which Admin role has.
seed_data_creation: 4 sample surgeries exist in database with equipment and supplies
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sala de Operaciones module fully functional. Backend CRUD, equipment/supplies management, cancellation, and Excel/PDF exports all working. Frontend table, filters, create/edit modal, detail view, and row expansion all working. Permissions correctly enforced: Admin can create/edit, only SuperAdmin can delete/cancel.

backend.GET /api/surgeries: PASS - List surgeries with filters (date, surgeon, institution, eye)
backend.POST /api/surgeries: PASS - Create surgery with/without IGSS data
backend.POST /api/surgeries/{id}/cancel: PASS - Cancel surgery with reason (SuperAdmin only)
backend.POST /api/surgeries/{id}/supplies: PASS - Add supply with cost calculation

frontend.page_loads: PASS - Sala de Operaciones page loads correctly
frontend.table_displays_data: PASS - 4 surgeries displayed with all columns
frontend.filters_work: PASS - Search, surgeon, institution, eye, date filters present
frontend.export_dropdown: PASS - Export button with Excel/PDF options
frontend.create_modal: PASS - Register Surgery button opens modal with all fields
frontend.igss_fields: PASS - IGSS fields appear when IGSS institution selected
frontend.detail_modal: PASS - View detail shows all surgery info including IGSS data, equipment, supplies
frontend.row_expansion: PASS - Expand row shows equipment and supplies with costs
frontend.cost_calculation: PASS - Total = procedure_cost + supplies_total displayed correctly
frontend.admin_permissions: PASS - Admin can see Edit but not Delete buttons
frontend.superadmin_permissions: PASS - SuperAdmin can see Edit, Delete, and Cancel buttons
